item: User manual section 3.0c Simple view, x12
summary: The user manual gains section 3.0c Simple view (after 3.0b Feed) in English and the 11 translations: the top-bar switch remembered per device, the six views (Today, Read, Search, World, Numbers, More tools), the info button and the ~ partial/stale marks, and the safety surfaces that never change. UI labels quoted as the simple-mode locale files show them. Translated manuals' coverage comments now read 125 of 125 headings.
